papers.title: Celebrating 20 years of Nature Protocols
papers.summary: Since Nature Protocols launched in 2006, protocol sharing has shifted from the margins to mainstream practice. Before the launch of online protocol journals, researchers relied on protocol textbooks, research papers and word of mouth. Now, researchers can choose from a range of platforms and journals to access and disseminate detailed step-by-step protocols
papers.llm_title_zh: 庆祝《自然·方法》出版20周年
papers.llm_title_bilingual: 庆祝《自然·方法》出版20周年 / Celebrating 20 years of Nature Protocols
papers.llm_research_question_zh: 自《自然·方法》于2006年创刊以来，实验方案的共享已从边缘行为转变为主流实践。
llm_highlights_zh: 在在线实验方案期刊问世之前，研究人员主要依靠实验方案教材、研究论文以及口耳相传的信息来获取相关资料。
如今，研究人员可以选择多种平台和期刊来获取并传播这些详细的、分步骤的操作指南。

papers.title: Reading and writing neural activity with Neuropixels Opto probes
papers.summary: High-density electrophysiology devices allow neuroscientists to observe spikes from large populations of neurons, and optogenetics allows them to drive or suppress those spikes. We show that a single device can combine these two capabilities, providing a high-resolution means to both read and write neural activity in the living brain
papers.llm_title_zh: 使用Neuropixels光敏电极来检测与记录神经活动
papers.llm_title_bilingual: 使用Neuropixels光敏电极来检测与记录神经活动 / Reading and writing neural activity with Neuropixels Opto probes
papers.llm_research_question_zh: 高密度电生理学设备使神经科学家能够观察大量神经元产生的电信号脉冲，而光遗传学技术则使他们能够操控或抑制这些脉冲的产生。
llm_highlights_zh: 我们证明，单一设备就能够同时具备这两种功能，从而为实时读取和记录活体大脑中的神经活动提供高分辨率的技术手段。

papers.title: Neuropixels Opto: combining high-resolution electrophysiology and optogenetics
papers.summary: Neuropixels Opto probes combine high-density recording sites with optical waveguide-based light emission sites for simultaneous recording of neuronal activity and optogenetic stimulation with blue and/or red light. As demonstrated in the mouse brain, these probes allow the activation or silencing of defined groups of neurons while acquiring high-quality recordings
papers.llm_title_zh: Neuropixels Opto：将高分辨率电生理技术与光遗传学相结合的技术。
papers.llm_title_bilingual: Neuropixels Opto：将高分辨率电生理技术与光遗传学相结合的技术。 / Neuropixels Opto: combining high-resolution electrophysiology and optogenetics
papers.llm_research_question_zh: Neuropixels光敏探针将高密度记录单元与基于光学波导的光源装置结合在一起，从而能够同时记录神经元活动，并利用蓝光和/或红光进行光遗传学刺激。
llm_highlights_zh: 正如在小鼠大脑中所展示的那样，这些探针能够精确地激活或抑制特定神经元群体，同时还能获得高质量的实验数据。

all_papers.summary: Neuropixels Opto probes combine high-density recording sites with optical waveguide-based light emission sites for simultaneous recording of neuronal activity and optogenetic stimulation with blue and/or red light. all_papers.title: Celebrating 20 years of Nature Protocols
all_papers.summary: Since Nature Protocols launched in 2006, protocol sharing has shifted from the margins to mainstream practice. Before the launch of online protocol journals, researchers relied on protocol textbooks, research papers and word of mouth. Now, researchers can choose from a range of platforms and journals to access and disseminate detailed step-by-step protocols
